rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: split:refrain.1.1: p299-strip800.jpg and p299-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system (the hymn's third), its one row: the word where the split opens a line is a name of God, printed with a capital anyway. The header (p299-strip0.jpg) prints 7.7.7.7. for the stanzas and only 'Ref.' for the refrain, so no metre fixes the refrain's lines. join:refrain.1.1: p299-strip800.jpg and p299-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system, its one row: the second line opens on 'O', printed with a capital anyway. The header (p299-strip0.jpg) gives the refrain no syllable counts, only 'Ref.', so no metre fixes its lines. movedown:refrain.1.1: p299-strip800.jpg and p299-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system, its one row: the moved word is a pronoun of God printed with a capital, and 'O' after it is printed with a capital too. The header (p299-strip0.jpg) gives the refrain no syllable counts, so no metre fixes its lines. moveup:refrain.1.1: p299-strip800.jpg and p299-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system, its one row: the moved word is 'O', printed with a capital anyway, and the changed line 2 opens on a pronoun of God, printed with a capital. The header (p299-strip0.jpg) gives the refrain no syllable counts, so no metre fixes its lines. split:refrain.1.2: p299-strip800.jpg and p299-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system, its one row: the word where the split opens a line is a title of Christ, printed with a capital anyway (the page capitalizes it mid-line in stanza 4 too). The header (p299-strip0.jpg) gives the refrain no syllable counts, so no metre fixes its lines.
